fusions.name: Bog Boom
fusions.desc: A deep croak sends a shockwave 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Mire Snare
fusions.desc: Flicks a glob of mud that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Dry-Season Sleep
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Boggy Constitution
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
